title: Add Medication entity
description: Room entity for a medication a profile can be dosed with, covering both interval-based (MVP) and fixed-schedule (modeled but not yet implemented) dosing.
acceptance_criteria: @Entity(tableName = "medications") data class Medication with an autoGenerate Int primary key id

Fields: name: String, dosingMode: DosingMode = DosingMode.INTERVAL, defaultDose: String, minIntervalMinutes: Int? = null, maxDailyDoses: Int? = null, fixedTimesOfDay: String? = null, notes: String? = null, isArchived: Boolean = false, createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
